description: Viewer for Autodesk® Data Connector for Power BI "Autodesk® Data Connector for Power BI" allows you to load Data Exchanges that are created and shared by other Autodesk and non-Autodesk applications, including custom enterprise applications, such as Autodesk® Revit®, Autodesk® Inventor®, Rhino, Power Automate, Grasshopper, Dynamo, Tekla, and Autodesk® Civil 3D®. The connector seamlessly integrates with Microsoft Business Intelligence platform. It fetches data from Data Exchanges and feeds them into Microsoft Power BI to construct comprehensive reports and dashboards. This connector provides robust data visualization, analysis, and connectivity to various data sources.
keywords: Autodesk® Data Connector for Power BI - Viewer
